answers.sql: SELECT (p2.val - p1.val) * 100.0 / p1.val AS value FROM (SELECT transfer_volume AS val FROM exports WHERE period = 'P1') p1, (SELECT transfer_volume AS val FROM exports WHERE period = 'P2') p2;

SELECT (p2.val - p1.val) * 100.0 / p1.val AS value FROM (SELECT SUM(amount_units) AS val FROM events WHERE period = 'P1' AND event_kind != 'mint' AND event_kind != 'burn') p1, (SELECT SUM(amount_units) AS val FROM events WHERE period = 'P2' AND event_kind != 'mint' AND event_kind != 'burn') p2;
